properties.notes: Town centre site operating as a Royal Mail depot. New premises would be required before relocation and there is no indication of intended timescale for this at the present time. Not available for housing development currently but it is understood options may be considered in the future. Likely to be a long term scheme circumstances do change. A high-density development for flats/apartments could be fitting for the location but the identified yield also reflects a reduced site area based on site constraints.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
